title: Goodwill Credits Counted in an Insurance Claim Services Credited-Line Write-Off
content:
**Rule.** In the Insurance Claim Services credited-line write-off, the goodwill credits are narrowed as follows: when the estimate was submitted on or before the water job's drying complete date, none, because the scope-sheet price that estimate carried is not the invoiced price a goodwill credit gives up; when it was submitted after the drying complete date but before the invoiced date, only the goodwill credits against the job's equipment-day lines dated on its last equipment day (one line per equipment type per day), because that estimate priced equipment from the daily log and every other line from the scope sheet; otherwise every goodwill credit posted on the job, because the estimate carried the invoiced price that a goodwill credit gives up.

The dates, the equipment-day lines and the goodwill adjustment credits are those of the Water Damage Mitigation job; the estimate submission date is the claim file's. The last equipment day is the latest service date among the job's equipment-day lines.

## Three periods

1. **Estimate on or before drying complete** — no goodwill credit.
2. **Estimate after drying complete, before invoicing** — only goodwill credits correcting an equipment-day line dated on the last equipment day.
3. **Estimate on or after the invoiced date** — every goodwill credit on the job.

*Hypothetical:* last equipment day 8 August (also the drying complete date), invoiced 14 August; goodwill credits of 64.00 against a dehumidifier line dated 8 August and 41.00 against a dehumidifier line dated 7 August. Estimate 10 August: 64.00. Estimate 14 August: 105.00.
